summary: Streaming remote Puppy replies and clearer trusted-machine controls.

improvements: Remote Puppy replies stream as your trusted machine generates them.
Choose an installed local model for one chat or set the machine default for future chats.
fixes: Puppy shows first-response progress, cancellation, and a bounded failure instead of spinning indefinitely.
This machine reports when its model, capacity, and work readings were last observed.
Settings and Feed show the same observed update phase and retain the last verified version during refresh.
security: Model changes require an owner-authorized, device-acknowledged command bound to the current pod.
The inference-only Puppy relay cannot change the trusted machine's default model.
